prompt:
Create a production game environment asset for an interactive HTML strategy map, based on the attached approved woodland kingdom concept. Reference role: style and art direction only. Output ONE landscape 4:3 illustration, full bleed map scenery only. REMOVE ALL interface: no title, no panels, no cards, no labels, no text, no numerals, no UI controls, no question marks or floating icons. This will sit underneath real clickable HTML controls.
Match the concept's rich painterly fantasy strategy aesthetic: deep emerald forest shadows, vivid turquoise flowing river, warm golden afternoon light, amber/orange roofs, honey gold highlights, lush foliage and wisps of pale mist at the edges. High detail, inviting and readable, adorable animal woodland world, no people. Camera high isometric/overhead so the entire small region is visible.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION for exactly seven interaction areas, coordinates are percent of canvas width and height:
1. WEST CAMP centered (12%,49%): charming small woodland tent/camp and a beaver by timber crates, occupies about 15% width and 16% height.
2. NORTH FOX FORT centered (49%,27%): timber/palisade fortress with orange roof and amber banner, about 18% width and 21% height.
3. SOUTH RIVER KEEP centered (51%,72%): timber fortified watermill beside a turquoise river, orange roof and forest-green banner, about 18% width and 21% height.
4. NORTHEAST SQUIRREL CITADEL centered (80%,38%): fortified treehouse citadel on a rocky knoll with red/amber banner, about 18% width and 22% height.
5. Secret trail clearing centered (29%,18%): small ruined arch in mist, clear round foreground patch.
6. Secret trail clearing centered (29%,78%): small mossy ruin in mist, clear round foreground patch.
7. Secret trail clearing centered (75%,79%): small stone circle in mist, clear round foreground patch.
Clear warm stepping-stone paths connect west camp to both outer forts and the two nearby trail clearings, and outer forts to northeast citadel and southeast trail. A winding turquoise creek flows from the distant north down through the south watermill, with small arched wooden bridges on crossings. Keep paths visually navigable, not a maze. Leave open grass near (30%,49%) for real animal party sprites to overlay; do NOT paint a travelling party into the asset. Keep all seven areas unobscured by foreground foliage. No extra castles, no extra camps, no monsters, no giant animal faces. Make this a beautiful continuous playable forest valley environment rather than a physical tabletop or an oval schematic map. Preserve contrast between warm settlements and cool deep green forest.
notes: Painted setting sits beneath real HTML controls. Labels, statuses, army, resources and recruitment are live DOM; no UI is baked into this asset.
